guides.title: Product Management
guides.html:

  • Write backlog items with business rules, acceptance criteria and scope boundaries.

guides.title: Lifecycle handoffs
guides.html:
Product lifecycle and team handoffs

A proposed sequence for coordinated delivery. Every gate below still needs evidence and an agreed owner; no release or budget is authorised by this list.

StageLead functionRequired handoffCross-team check
1. DiscoverProduct Management + UX researchProblem, user evidence, outcomes and constraintsLead BA records ambiguous rules and decision owners.
2. Define and prioritiseProduct Management + Lead BAScope baseline, backlog, acceptance criteria and roadmapEngineering estimates feasibility; QA checks testability; budget assumptions remain explicit.
3. DesignUX/UI DesignPrototype, component states and responsive specificationsProduct validates intent; Engineering and QA review feasibility and coverage.
4. BuildEngineering & DevReviewed implementation, API contracts and CI evidenceQA receives a testable build and environment; Operations receives deployment requirements.
5. ValidateQuality & Testing + Product + DesignTest evidence, defects, usability findings and acceptance decisionRelease owner assesses unresolved risks; a mock flow alone cannot establish production readiness.
6. Release and supportEngineering + Operations & SupportRelease checklist, monitoring, rollback and support readinessCommunication prepares approved customer updates and known-issue notes.
7. Learn and improveOperations + Product Management + CommunicationFeedback, incidents, outcome measures and follow-up actionsReturn evidence to backlog prioritisation; changes enter through scope control.

guides.title: Per-page team coverage
guides.html:
Apply this checklist to every page and journey

Use the existing 43-page inventory and 10 journey checklists as the coverage baseline. For each page or cross-page flow, attach the six records below. Coverage status for all six functions is currently Not reviewed.

Review dimensionRecord for each page or journeyProposed review owner
ProductUser problem, role, business rules, acceptance criteria, priority and success measureProduct manager + Lead BA
DesignWireframe/prototype, component states, accessibility, themes and responsive behaviourDesigner
EngineeringUI/service ownership, API/data contracts, permission boundaries, persistence and technical dependenciesEngineering lead
QualityRequirement-linked cases, supported browsers, API checks, automated coverage and defect evidenceQA lead
OperationsFailure detection, support article, incident owner, recovery and feedback intakeOperations / support lead
CommunicationInternal decision record, release-note impact and customer/support update needsDelivery / communication owner

Record format: page/journey ID, function, named owner, requirement or outcome, deliverable/evidence link, status, dependencies, next action, review date and decision. Record an explicit reason for any not-applicable item.

Readiness rule: count only evidence-backed reviews as complete. Do not treat a populated checklist, a prototype or a successful build as proof of full product readiness.

guides.title: Cross-cutting checks
guides.html:
Shared surfaces and cross-cutting checks

AreaChecklist
Navigation and nested screensSidebar, profile menu, mode switch, breadcrumbs, back/forward, direct links, refresh and nested record selection. Confirm route reachability.
Additional route patternsLegacy /assessment-suite/blueprint alias; Student Management record paths and optional institution prefix in src/App.jsx. Nested records belong under Student Management, not extra registry pages.
Overlays and stepsInventory every tab, drawer, popup, wizard, preview and confirmation within each page; check open, close, cancel, Escape, focus trap/restore and scroll. This nested inventory is pending.
Data and persistenceStatic sample data, API boundaries, loading, empty/error states, validation, duplicate actions, retries, stale records and refresh recovery.
Roles and securityInstitution boundary, record ownership, view/edit/assign/evaluate/approve/release actions and denied access. Faculty/Student navigation modes do not grant permissions.
Design and accessibilityMedsy tokens, labels, contrast, numeric alignment, table overflow, focus, keyboard, hover/press/loading/disabled states and reduced motion.
Responsive and themesMobile 0?767px; tablet 768?1023px; desktop 1024?1439px; wide desktop 1440px+. Light/dark/OLED where supported; collapsed sidebar and overlays.
Shell utilitiesNotifications, fullscreen, theme, demo videos, profile settings, ID guide, sign-out and sample-account controls where present.
Recovery and historyCancellation, return for correction, resubmission, lock/unlock rules, failed writes, audit history and downstream consistency.
Report accuracyCounts, filters, denominators, released versus unreleased results, empty datasets and drill-down consistency.

guides.title: Senior / Lead BA responsibilities
guides.html:
Senior / Lead Business Analyst responsibilities

Responsibilities and required outputs for the later review. Owners, priorities, effort and budget remain unassigned until supported by evidence.

ResponsibilityRequired output
Resolve ambiguityDecision log with rule, options, recommendation, owner and affected flows.
Maintain traceabilityBusiness objective ? requirement ? page/journey ? acceptance criteria ? evidence ? finding.
Validate rolesAction matrix for view, create, edit, assign, evaluate, approve, release and administration; include negative access checks.
Protect baseline scopeRecord baseline version; separate defects, missing agreed requirements and proposed enhancements; require change-impact decisions.
Design strategic roadmapSequence work by user impact, risk and dependencies; record outcomes, owners and release gates. No dates committed in this inventory.
Inform budget allocationCompare effort ranges, assumptions, expected value and operational cost; request agreed rates before monetary estimates. No budget committed.
Mentor junior analystsProvide example findings, reproducible steps and evidence standards; review analysis before sign-off.
Manage risks and dependenciesRecord severity, likelihood, affected roles, mitigation, dependency owner and unresolved decisions.
Recommend release readinessUse verified acceptance evidence and unresolved blockers; never infer production readiness from mock data or source presence.

guides.title: Evidence and status rules
guides.html:
Evidence and status rules

Verified for this inventory: registered labels and route mappings from src/config/appPages.js and src/App.jsx. Working behaviour, backend integration and production parity are outside this list-only pass.

StatusUse when
Not reviewedEvidence collection has not started. Current status for every page in this report.
In reviewInspection or testing is underway; no final conclusion.
Verified passDefined acceptance checks passed; attach environment, date and evidence.
PartialSome checks passed, with explicitly listed gaps.
FailedA reproducible acceptance requirement failed.
BlockedA named requirement, access or dependency prevents verification.
Not applicableAn item is excluded with a documented reason.

Each later finding should record: requirement ID, page and journey, role, expected behaviour, actual behaviour, reproduction steps, evidence, environment, source version, review date, severity, owner, decision and acceptance criteria.

Scope control: maintain the agreed baseline separately from proposed enhancements. This reference does not authorise fixes, releases or budget changes. It does not claim that all nested flows have already been discovered.
